description_en: Refreshes the metadata of a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source
description_zh: 重新拉取MMA数据源的元数据
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute update-mms-data-source --source-id 2000017 --name dept1 --action UPDATE_CONFIG --test true --config key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMmsDataSource

parameters.description_en: The ID of the data source.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.description_en: The new name of the data source.
parameters.help_en: The new name of the data source
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en:
The type of the update operation:

1. UPDATE\_CONFIG: updates the data source configuration.
2. START: starts the data source instance.
3. STOP: shuts down the data source instance.
4. RENAME: renames the data source.
parameters.description_zh:
更新操作类型：
1. UPDATE_CONFIG： 更新数据源配置
2. START：启动数据源实例
3. STOP：关闭数据源实例
4. RENAME: 重命名
